question: Recommend asset classes to invest when the USD currency is appreciated, and when it is depreciated
query: SELECT date, stock_index, forex_usd_eur, forex_usd_jpy, gdp_growth, inflation_rate, interest_rate, consumer_confidence_index, government_debt, corporate_profits, retail_sales, real_estate_index, consumer_spending  FROM finance_economics_dataset  WHERE (forex_usd_eur > 1.05 OR forex_usd_jpy > 110)  ORDER BY date  LIMIT 50;
